AccountLayout.title: Account
AccountLayout.description: Manage your profile and how you sign in.

AccountProfile.title: Profile
AccountProfile.description: How you appear across the app.
AccountProfile.name: Name
AccountProfile.emailDescription: Your email is your sign-in name and can't be changed here.

AccountDelete.title: Delete account
AccountDelete.description: Permanently remove your account and everything tied to it.
AccountDelete.dialogDescription: Your profile, passkeys and sessions are removed immediately. This can't be undone.

AccountPassword.title: Password
AccountPassword.description: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
AccountPassword.reused: Choose a password you haven't used here
AccountPassword.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

AccountTwoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
AccountTwoFactor.description: Ask for a code from your authenticator app after your password.
AccountTwoFactor.scanDescription: Use an authenticator app such as 1Password, Authy or Google Authenticator, then enter the code it shows.
AccountTwoFactor.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter this key instead:
AccountTwoFactor.codesDescription: If you lose your authenticator, each code signs you in once. Store them somewhere safe: they won't be shown again.
AccountTwoFactor.regenerateDescription: Your current backup codes stop working as soon as new ones are generated.
AccountTwoFactor.disableDescription: Signing in will only need your password or a passkey.

AccountBackupCodes.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the codes and copy them manually.

AccountPasskeys.title: Passkeys
AccountPasskeys.description: Sign in without a password, using your device's fingerprint, face or PIN.
AccountPasskeys.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
AccountPasskeys.dialogDescription: Name it after the device or password manager that holds it, then follow your browser's prompt.

AccountSessions.title: Sessions
AccountSessions.description: Devices signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognise.
AccountSessions.signOutOthers: Sign out of all other devices
AccountSessions.revokedOthers: Signed out of all other devices

AccountVerifyEmail.dialogDescription: Enter the {length}-digit code we sent to {email}.
